title: 第十四章 大哥的信

如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    楚枫笑了，笑的很邪恶，他将匕首高高举起，淡淡的吐出了一个字
话音刚落，楚枫手中的匕首便猛然下落。
“我错了！！！”
“我错了，楚枫弟我错了，饶了我吧，求你...不要废掉我的修为，不要...”楚成疯狂般的大吼起来，声音中竟然夹带着哭腔。
而他此话一出，楚枫的动作也赫然停下，笑眯眯的打量起此刻的楚成。
这才发现，楚成闭着眼睛，两行泪水狂涌而出，张着的大嘴还在不住的求饶。
不止脸上表情苦逼，连身体都在颤抖，甚至胯下已是湿润大片，一股恶臭散发而来。
楚枫将匕首仍在了地上，在楚成和楚真的身上一顿摸索，最终搜出五株下品灵药“地灵草”。
做完这些，楚枫又来到楚成面前，他轻轻的拍了拍楚成的脸庞，说道：
“你看看你这幅模样，究竟谁是废物，你心里还不清楚么？”
“哈哈...”说完这些，楚枫哈哈一笑，这才潇洒的离去。
而在楚风离开后，楚成与楚真也是相互搀扶，跌跌撞撞的消失在了夜色中。
可就在他们离开不久，一道倩影却在黑暗之中走出，这位竟是楚月。
只不过，楚月那甜美的脸颊上，却已布满了惊愕之色。
良久之后，她喃喃自语道：“楚枫弟，你究竟是怎样的一个人，究竟有着怎样的实力。”
突然，她闭上了眼睛，想起了小时候的楚枫。
无论人们怎样讥讽，都从不还口。
无论别人怎样欺辱，都从不还手。
脸上始终挂着笑容，让人感到可怜，让人感到心疼，让人想要保护的楚枫。
终于，楚月睁开了双眼，她释然的笑了：

“也许，我们都错了，错把你看成一个懦弱的人。”
“也许，这才是真的你，你从不需要他人保护，因为你强大到足以保护他人。”
此刻的楚枫，已是回到了自己的府邸，他将三株仙灵草，和五株地灵草取了出来。
地灵草虽是下品灵药，不过也是修武珍品，楚枫觉得将它们掠夺来，足够让楚成和楚真痛心不已了。
只要想到，这两个平日常侮辱他的兄弟，刚刚被自己教训的情境，楚枫仍感觉极为爽快。
“看来有句话说的很对，恶人还需恶人磨，想跟恶人讲道理，就必须用拳头。”
楚枫笑了笑，并未急着开始修炼，而是将他大哥的信函取了出来。
信函“弟，距离你拜入青龙宗，已过五载，而我兄弟二人也五年未曾见面。”
“再过些时日，便又到了家族每年一次的族会，今年族会爷爷将退出家主之位。”
“爷爷的退出，也代表着新任家主的选举，而父亲将成为新任家主的竞选者之一。”
“这对父亲来说，是极为重要的日子，所以我希望今年的族会你能够回来，与我一同为父亲打气。”
寥寥几行字，已是道明了信中之意，楚枫将信纸合并，陷入了沉思。
每年族会，楚家的年轻一代，都会进行切磋比试，来测试修炼的成果。
虽然表面是测试，但实际上后辈的潜力，也间接决定着长辈在族内的地位。
这次楚渊，能够获得信任家族的竞选资格，除了个人实力强悍外，也与楚孤雨有着绝对的关系。
楚孤雨，楚家年轻一代，唯一一个拜入凌云宗的人。
几乎每年都能夺得族比第一名，他的潜力如此之大，自然也影响了楚渊的地位。
沉思过后，楚枫便找出纸笔，书写起对楚孤雨的回信。
内容很简单，今年的族会他会回去，因为楚枫也想为父亲竞选家主出一份力。
他想在这次的族比之中大放异彩，至少获得一个不错的名次，让所有人都知道，楚渊的两个儿子没有庸才。

换句话说，楚枫觉得，证明自己的时候到了。
书写完毕，楚枫又将三株仙灵草，和五株地灵草全部炼化。
这一次，楚枫终于感觉到丹田被填充的感觉，据他估计，再炼化二十株仙灵草，说不定就可以突破。
只不过，二十株仙灵草，绝对是天价，所以他唯一的寄托，全部都放在了明日的灵药狩猎上。
次日清晨，天刚朦朦亮，但在青龙宗北部一座浩瀚的广场上，已是聚集了上万人，这里正是进入灵药山的入口之一。
楚枫背着两个包裹，一个满是食物，另一个则空空如也，正在人群中东张西望，寻找着楚月。

content_en:
If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. Chu Feng smiled, and his smile was evil. He raised the dagger high and faintly uttered one word.
As soon as he finished speaking, the dagger in Chu Feng's hand suddenly dropped.
"I was wrong!!!"
"I was wrong, brother Chu Feng, I was wrong, please spare me, please... don't destroy my cultivation, don't..." Chu Cheng yelled like crazy, with a cry in his voice.
As soon as he said these words, Chu Feng stopped suddenly and looked at Chu Cheng with a smile.
Only then did he realize that Chu Cheng had his eyes closed, tears welling up in his eyes, and his big mouth was still begging for mercy.
Not only was the expression on his face miserable, but his body was trembling, and his crotch was even covered in moisture, and a foul odor emanated from it.
Chu Feng put the dagger on the ground, groped around Chu Cheng and Chu Zhen, and finally found five low-grade elixir "Earth Spirit Grass".
After doing this, Chu Feng came to Chu Cheng again. He gently patted Chu Cheng's face and said:
"Look at your appearance. Don't you still know who the waste is?"
"Haha..." After saying this, Chu Feng laughed and then left gracefully.
After Chu Feng left, Chu Cheng and Chu Zhen also supported each other and stumbled into the night.
But not long after they left, a beautiful figure walked out of the darkness. This figure turned out to be Chu Yue.
However, Chu Yue's sweet cheeks were already filled with astonishment.
After a long time, she murmured to herself: "Brother Chu Feng, what kind of person are you and what kind of strength do you have."
Suddenly, she closed her eyes and remembered Chu Feng when she was a child.
No matter how much people ridicule, they never talk back.
No matter how others bully you, you never fight back.
Chu Feng always has a smile on his face, which makes people feel pitiful, distressed and wants to protect him.
Finally, Chu Yue opened her eyes, and she smiled with relief:
"Perhaps we were all wrong and mistook you for a coward."
"Perhaps, this is the real you. You never need protection from others, because you are strong enough to protect others."
At this moment, Chu Feng had returned to his mansion. He took out three fairy grasses and five earthly grasses.
Although the Earth Spirit Grass is a low-grade elixir, it is also a treasure for cultivating martial arts. Chu Feng felt that plundering them would be enough to make Chu Cheng and Chu Zhen extremely distressed.
As long as he thought about the situation where these two brothers who usually insulted him had just been taught a lesson by him, Chu Feng still felt extremely happy.
"It seems that there is a saying that is right. Evil people need to be punished by evil people. If you want to reason with evil people, you must use your fists."
Chu Feng smiled and did not rush to start practicing. Instead, he took out his eldest brother's letter.
Letter: "Brother, it has been five years since you joined the Qinglong Sect, and my two brothers have not seen each other for five years."
"In a few days, the family's annual clan meeting will come again. This year, Grandpa will step down as the head of the clan."
"Grandpa's withdrawal also represents the election of the new head of the family, and my father will be one of the candidates for the new head of the family."
"This is an extremely important day for my father, so I hope you can come back to this year's clan meeting and cheer for my father with me."
A few lines of words clearly stated the meaning of the letter. Chu Feng combined the letters and fell into deep thought.
Every year at the clan meeting, the younger generation of the Chu family will compete in competitions to test the results of their cultivation.
Although it is a test on the surface, in fact the potential of the younger generation also indirectly determines the status of the elders within the clan.
This time, Chu Yuan was able to qualify for the Trust Family. In addition to his strong personal strength, he also had an absolute relationship with Chu Guyu.
Chu Guyu, the younger generation of the Chu family, was the only one to join the Lingyun Sect.
Winning first place in the clan competition almost every year, his potential is so great, it naturally affects Chu Yuan's status.
After pondering, Chu Feng found a pen and paper and wrote a reply to Chu Guyu.
The content is very simple. He will go back to this year's clan meeting because Chu Feng also wants to contribute to his father's election as the head of the clan.
He wanted to shine in this clan competition, at least get a good ranking, and let everyone know that Chu Yuan's two sons were not mediocre.
In other words, Chu Feng felt that the time had come to prove himself.
After finishing writing, Chu Feng refined three fairy grasses and five earthly grasses.
This time, Chu Feng finally felt the feeling of his Dantian being filled. According to his estimate, he might be able to break through by refining twenty more fairy grasses.
However, twenty fairy grasses were absolutely priceless, so his only hope was placed on tomorrow's elixir hunt.
In the early morning of the next day, the sky was dim and bright, but tens of thousands of people had already gathered in a vast square in the north of Qinglong Sect. This was one of the entrances to the Spiritual Medicine Mountain.
Chu Feng was carrying two packages, one full of food and the other empty. He was looking around in the crowd, looking for Chu Yue.
